images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 first-person screenshot of a quiet art game where the player is underwater beneath a flooded house, looking straight up at the underside of the living-room floorboards. Strong worm's-eye perspective: long wet planks converge toward the centre, thin lines of warm lamplight leak through the gaps between them, a heavy wooden joist crosses the ceiling. Dark blurred footprint shadows of a family walk across the boards; the newest step is marked by a soft expanding golden ripple ring. Pale caustic light dances on the wood, suspended silt particles and slow rising bubbles fill the murky green water, and a drowned wooden chair and a child's shoe float half-lost in the gloom below. Minimal HUD: a small location caption top-left, three family names with coloured dots top-right, a centred subtitle naming whose footsteps these are. Korean UI: "익사한 집", "엄마의 발소리", "거실 아래". Melancholic, murky teal-green and black with thin threads of amber light, film grain, deep vignette.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 first-person screenshot of the emotional beat of an underwater art game. The same upward perspective under the floorboards, but now a large gap in the boards glows with warm golden dinner light. Through the gap, in silhouette, the legs of a dining table and chairs: an adult's feet resting on the floor, a child's feet dangling above it, and one empty chair between them. The warm light floods through every plank gap and blooms into the dark water, dust glowing like embers. In the lower right a pale, water-blue translucent hand reaches upward toward the boards. Bubbles drift up. Minimal HUD: location caption top-left, three family names with warm dots top-right, a left-aligned subtitle about the empty chair at seven in the evening. Korean UI: "저녁 일곱 시", "식탁 아래", "익사한 집". Tender and aching, amber gold against near-black olive water, soft bloom, film grain, vignette. Text constraints: the three family names top-right read exactly "엄마", "아빠", "아이", spelled correctly.
